title: Place Saves
statement: Implement `solve(order_id, amount)`. If the amount is not a positive int, return `{"status": "error", "row": "none"}`. Otherwise return `{"status": "ok", "row": "order_id:amount"}`. Checkout saves through the store. The row is what a test reads back.
constraints: A rejected amount does not write a row
The row text includes both fields
hints: On failure, the row is the string none.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Asserting the saved row is stronger than asserting that a method was called.

editorial: Asserting the saved row is stronger than asserting that a method was called. The fake store's contents are the behavior. A charge that never landed fails this check even if a mock recorded a call with the right name.
